source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U04: Identify security agreement, secured asset, secured debt and excluded interests separately

facts.statement: Security agreement creates the interest, secured asset is charged property, secured debt is debt secured by interest. Security interest definition is read with section31 exclusions; secured creditor includes specified banks/FIs, ARCs and trustees.

payload.title: Draw the security relationship before taking action
payload.core_explanation_md:
The security agreement is the arrangement creating the relevant interest; it can include the described mortgage by deposit of title deeds. The secured asset is the property carrying that interest. Secured debt is the debt protected by it. The secured creditor is the qualifying holder under the statutory definition, which extends to the specified ARC and trustee situations. These are related terms with different jobs.

The security-interest definition must be read with the section 31 exclusions. A party can hold a financial claim without having a statutory enforcement right over every borrower asset. Check what interest was actually created, for whose benefit, over what property and whether an exclusion applies.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an unsecured balance become secured merely because the creditor is a bank?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. A qualifying creditor does not replace the need for the actual security relationship.

payload.stem_md: A banker identifies a valid security agreement over one warehouse and labels all company assets secured assets. What mapping is needed?

options.text_md: Every company asset becomes charged whenever any warehouse is charged
options.explanation_md: A specific security relationship does not automatically extend to all property.

options.text_md: Identify the actual property on which the relevant security interest was created
options.explanation_md: Secured asset refers to the property carrying that interest.

options.text_md: Treat the agreement document itself as every asset in the company
options.explanation_md: The document creates or records the relationship; it is not all collateral.

options.text_md: Delete the secured-debt amount because an agreement exists
options.explanation_md: Security does not itself discharge the debt.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Secured asset refers to the property carrying that interest.

payload.stem_md: A file contains a financial claim and a proposed collateral description but no established security creation. Which statement is justified?

options.text_md: A proposed description proves completed security creation
options.explanation_md: A proposal is not proof that the interest was created.

options.text_md: All bank financial claims are secured by definition
options.explanation_md: The financial-asset definition includes unsecured claims.

options.text_md: Creditor status alone proves section 31 can never matter
options.explanation_md: The statutory exclusions must still be examined.

options.text_md: The claim and the established security relationship must be tested separately
options.explanation_md: The definitions answer different legal questions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The definitions answer different legal questions.
